description.value: Sea Drift Fish Co. is a family-run wholesale seafood operation on Vancouver Island, established in 1979 and focused on sustainably sourced local fish. The company serves seafood wholesalers, processors, and fishermen, offering custom cutting, freezing, bait, and ice. A touring cyclist passing through Nanaimo with a cooler or looking to buy fresh local seafood may find this a distinctive stop.

address.value: 248 Southside Dr, Nanaimo, British Columbia V9R 6Z5
